inputs.retrieval_mode: Same active locale only. The caller prefixes each question with the accepted E5 query prefix and passes the normalized vector only to ExactLocaleRetriever.
inputs.no_evidence_rule: A reviewed boundary question with a technical identifier absent from the active locale metadata abstains before embedding, retrieval, or generation.

runtime.implementation: Checksum-verified E5-base ONNX CPU encoder plus app.documentation.retrieval.ExactLocaleRetriever.

integrity_and_recovery.active_generation: Validate the active pointer, exact-generation manifests, source-manifest identity, per-locale chunk metadata and current reviewed provenance before measuring relevance.
integrity_and_recovery.failure_isolation: Corrupt, stale, malformed, or unavailable chat artifacts fail closed in the chat path. They never import, call, modify, or make unavailable the independent M4 deterministic documentation search.

boundaries.swap: Observed as an operational diagnostic only; it is not a validity or release condition.
boundaries.output: Write reports only under ignored documentation/.cache/bpm093-m5-08/.

progress.content: real runtime preparation, source/generation verification, locale-local evaluated-case completion, and measured latency samples; no synthetic progress or ETA
